title: Plan split
no_spec_change_rationale: Skill guidance for the plan-stage fork and the test-stage grouping loop; no canonical spec sentence changes and no helper behavior changes.
acceptance_criteria: The workflow skill's plan reference teaches an optional fork inside the one scope approval: one question, whether the slice can be cut into a left half and a right half with no shared file; one worker when it cannot; one manager and two workers when it can, the manager merging both reports and writing neither half; one fork as the batch, with another fork only when a half still has its own seam and the total stays at about four agents. After the merge the session records whether the halves joined cleanly, the wall-clock, and any conflict. The testing reference teaches the bounded fix-and-rerun loop on the focused set with grouping by cause before filing and one bug or one lesson per group, and the stages and build references agree; tests pin those sentences and the installed skill copy matches the source.
